sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Satyam Pandey,Chandrika Rani Upadhyay,Girish Kumar Pandey,Tripu Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
It is alleged in the First Information Report that the daughter of the informant went out from home on 22.11.2022 for Majar, however, since then she is missing.
Although the informant searched a lot but could not find her.
On 30.11.2022 the informant came to know that the applicant has enticed her daughter away.
One Masook as well as other villagers of the Village Paigu Sarai, have seen them.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the occurrence is of 22.11.2022.
F.I.R. has been lodged after delay of nine days on 1.12.2022.
The recovery of the dead body of the victim has been Pradeep vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Applicant has no criminal history.
Case is of circumstantial evidence and chain of circumstance is not complete.

He further submits that co-accused Irfan who was assigned the main role has been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 09.01.2024 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.5804 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.5804 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Applicant seeks parity with the bail order of co-accused Irfan (supra).
It is lastly submitted that there is no possibility of the applicant of fleeing away after being released from jail or tampering with the witnesses.
In case the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid facts as argued by the learned counsel for the applicant.

Considering the facts that the applicant has no previous criminal history, the delay in lodging the First Information Report, it is a case of circumstantial evidence so also the fact that applicant seeks parity with the bail order of co-accused Irfan (supra) and without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, I find it to be a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant,Pradeep involved in Case Crime No. 462 of 2022 under Sections 366, 376, 302,
307, 201, 392, 411, 34 I.P.C. Police Station Manjhila, District Hardoi be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
(iii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iv) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(v) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the Pradeep vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
